tasks.subject: Task 20: _ssl/_hashlib OpenSSL-3.0 symbol patch in percona-tarball-python3
tasks.description:
**Goal:** plpython3u `import ssl` works on OpenSSL-3.0 hosts (ssl3 variant) — CPython source patch (pgcrypto-Patch8 technique) forcing pre-3.3/pre-3.4 fallbacks so _ssl/_hashlib carry only OPENSSL_3.0.0 needs; spec %check pins it.

USER DECISION 2026-07-28: fix (option 2) rather than accept official-parity failure.

**Files:**
- Modify: root/ppg/common/deps/percona-tarball-python3/ (patch + spec)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- EL9 _ssl/_hashlib readelf: no OPENSSL_3.[1-9] needs; EL8 unchanged
- ubuntu:22.04 bare-postgres plpython3u DO import ssl: fails before, passes after
